unknown: Storage use can’t be read, so nothing was cleaned up.
low_free: Less than {minMb} MB free ({freeMb} MB left). Consider not keeping videos for now.
over_limit_practice: Storage is over the limit ({usedMb} MB used). During practice this is only a warning; nothing is deleted.

over_limit.one: Storage is over the limit ({usedMb} MB used). Export a backup first. Clean-up only deletes raw videos (oldest unstarred first), never a shot’s numbers or pose: {n} video can go, about {freedMb} MB.
over_limit.other: Storage is over the limit ({usedMb} MB used). Export a backup first. Clean-up only deletes raw videos (oldest unstarred first), never a shot’s numbers or pose: {n} videos can go, about {freedMb} MB.

over_limit_unsatisfied.one: Storage is over the limit ({usedMb} MB used). Deleting every video that can go ({n} video, about {freedMb} MB) is still not enough: export, then free space by hand.
over_limit_unsatisfied.other: Storage is over the limit ({usedMb} MB used). Deleting every video that can go ({n} videos, about {freedMb} MB) is still not enough: export, then free space by hand.
